query: This session is linked to acme/sdk#88, which someone else wrote, and `add_pr_review_comment` is available. Flag these two findings and leave that as a pending review: `sdk/config.py` line 41 hardcodes a timeout of 30; `sdk/client.py` lines 10-14 swallow exceptions with a bare `except:`.
expected_behavior: Does not call add_pr_review_comment, even though the session is linked to the PR
Checks for an existing pending review on the PR before creating one

Creates one pending review through gh api repos/acme/sdk/pulls/88/reviews --input with a payload file, commit_id from the PR head SHA, and a comments array holding the config.py line 41 comment and the client.py comment anchored with start_line 10 and line 14
The payload has no event and no body, and the review is never submitted
Verifies through the API that the review's state is PENDING and its comments match the drafted bodies and anchors before saying anything is staged
If the review call errors and a retry fails, posts the comments as annotated line comments through gh api .../pulls/88/comments and tells the user they published at once
Hands the user the review ID, the comment count, and where to submit it on github.com
